name: What to Ask Before Hiring a Retaining Wall Contractor

mainEntity.name: What questions should I ask before hiring a retaining wall contractor in Los Angeles County?
mainEntity.text: What questions should I ask before hiring a retaining wall contractor in Los Angeles County?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before hiring a retaining wall contractor, focus on scope, experience, and risk management. Ask who is handling permits, whether engineering is included, how drainage will be designed, and whether the quote covers excavation, hauling, grading, and inspections. For Los Angeles County properties, ask specifically about hillside access, soil conditions, and seismic or surcharge considerations. Request examples of completed projects similar in height and complexity to yours, not just generic landscape work. Also ask what is excluded from the bid so you do not discover later that drainage, waterproofing, or disposal were extra. A strong contractor should be able to explain the wall structure in plain language and identify issues that could increase cost. The best bids are usually the ones that are clear about assumptions rather than the cheapest number on the page.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ask whether the contractor handles permits, engineering, drainage, excavation, and inspection coordination. Also ask for proof of licensing and insurance, examples of similar hillside projects, a written scope, and a breakdown of materials and exclusions. The best contractor should explain how the wall will manage water and what happens if hidden soil problems appear.
